name: MacPorts 2.12.7
body:
Changes since 2.12.6:
 - Fixed error verifying signatures when multiple archive sites are
      configured and use different signature types.
      ([#74474](https://trac.macports.org/ticket/74474), pguyot in c225437)

 - Fixed building with system curl on 10.5. ([#74362](https://trac.macports.org/ticket/74362), jmr in 847bfc2)
